metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an exercise that can quickly relieve muscle tightness and pain at the front of the neck.

This is especially good for targeting a muscle known as the sternocleidomastoid (SCM), a big instigator of front neck pain and pain while trying to turn the head.

It can be done at home, requires no equipment, and can give quick neck pain relief... even within seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
